alt: Protected bike lane with green painted markings on Bloor Street in Toronto, with cyclists riding in the dedicated lane alongside parked cars
story: Ontario Premier Doug Ford issued a 110-page request for proposals on September 28, 2026, to remove 19 kilometres of protected bike lanes from Toronto's busiest streets — with bids due November 2026 and a first milestone deadline of April 1, 2027.
why_funny: The government answered demands to keep the pandemic-era lanes by formally contracting to dig up the same streets all over again, then scheduled the 'alternative routes' deadline on April Fools' Day.
